title: 7.12 Farm and Wild Animals
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Name four farm animals and four wild animals, and say what four of them are doing.
grammar_function: It is a/an + animal; The + animal + is + action.
prerequisite: 1.x running, eating, sleeping, drinking; 1.10 pets and The dog is running.; 2.4 It is a + noun.
speaking_outcome: Say It is a lion. and The horse is running.
